t: Durable thermostatic electric shower with easy installation. Multiple cable and water entry points. Easy to use dial to set preferred showering temperature. Swivel-fit connection allows for left and right-side water connection and swing-fit connectivity provides left and right-side cable connection with generous footprint for replacement installations. Plus Entry trims can easily be removed and fitted without tools. Supplied with an adjustable top bracket shower kit with 1.25m anti-twist hose.
b: Suitable for Cold Mains Water Only
